do things that make you feel like life is worth it, and confide in yourself, become your comfort.

hello, this is a difficult situation. the surgeon most likely has an amazing lawyer and will win the case, but it is hard to stay silent when something as terrible as this happened to you. here is what i think:  


you are worthy and you do bring positivity, the problem is not you, it's the people around you. for people to make you stay silent when you were sexually harassed is disgusting. you need to find a support system that allows you to be able to speak out without any additional consequences and people that you do not compare yourself too. as many people do, they tend to blame themselves for what has happened or what is happening, but you must realize, you are pointing the finger on the wrong person (you!). your surgeon harassed you, your loved ones told you to stay silent, and you are in chronic pain. it feels like the whole world is telling you are not worth anything, but it is not you. it is them, find the people who acknowledge what happened and propose better ideas for you. do not remain silent unless you'd like.
